Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored a goal on two shots, dished an assist, added two PIM and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Penguins.
Celebrini recorded three assists, including one on the power play, and six shots on goal in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Stars.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard scored an even-strength goal on two shots and added a power-play assist in Wednesday's 3-2 overtime win over the Flyers.
Bouchard scored a power-play goal on three shots, dished an assist and added two PIM in Thursday's 5-4 loss to the Ducks.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider had two assists, two shots on goal and two blocked shots in Thursday's 5-4 loss to the Panthers.
Seider scored a goal on six shots and added three hits in Tuesday's 3-2 loss to the Blues.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Thursday's 5-2 win over the Capitals.
Hughes notched two assists, including one on the power play, and fired three shots on net in Sunday's 4-0 win over the Maple Leafs.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier scored a goal on seven shots and added two hits in Wednesday's 4-2 loss to the Predators.
Gauthier scored three goals on six shots, added an assist and went plus-2 in Sunday's 5-2 win over the Penguins.

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Wednesday and is expected to miss 2-4 weeks.
Guenther (undisclosed) is questionable for Wednesday's matchup against Vegas, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News.
Dylan Guenther.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Brogan Houston (Deseret News.)

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun tallied a power-play goal, picked up an assist and launched five shots on net in Tuesday's 6-5 loss to Dallas.
Chychrun notched two assists, four shots on goal and five blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored a goal on three shots in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Panthers.
Tuch scored a goal, added two hits and blocked two shots in Thursday's 4-3 win over the Predators.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman gave up four goals on 17 shots before being replaced by Michael DiPietro midway through the second period of Thursday's 5-2 loss to the Canadiens.
Swayman will start Thursday's home game against the Canadiens, Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now reports.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jack Studley (Boston Hockey Now)

Brandt Clarke.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Dooley (Kings')

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) won't return to Thursday's game versus the Senators.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard scored a goal, dished an assist, added two hits and blocked two shots in Saturday's 9-2 loss to the Hurricanes.
Bedard picked up two assists while adding four shots on net, two hits, two PIM and a plus-1 rating in Wednesday's 5-3 loss to the Panthers.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck made 26 saves in Thursday's 5-2 win over the Capitals.
Hellebuyck is expected to start at home against Washington on Thursday.

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev tallied the game-winning goal and fired three shots on net in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Kraken.
Dorofeyev scored a power-play goal on four shots in Thursday's 3-2 win over the Flyers.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a power-play goal in Monday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Bruins.
Stone scored a power-play goal, added four hits and went minus-2 in Friday's 5-2 loss to the Devils.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal and added an even-strength assist in Monday's 5-3 win over the Panthers.
Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored a goal on four shots in a 4-2 loss to Montreal on Saturday.
McKenna scored two power-play goals, dished an assist and added two PIM in Wednesday's 5-4 loss to the Kraken.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek scored a goal on four shots, added two PIM, blocked two shots and went plus-2 in Tuesday's 4-2 win over the Flyers.

Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Corey Masisak (The Denver Post.)

Simon Edvinsson.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Andreas III Johnsson (Goteborgs-Posten)

Devon Levi.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Vince Z. Mercogliano (The Athletic)

Jack Quinn.summary: Quinn notches two assists (one on the power play) in Thursday's 3-2 overtime loss to the Blackhawks.
